text: I'm watching my baby brother, he's 2, mum's asleep cos she's been up two nights with him. His temp is 37.9. He's had a red blotchy rash on his chest since yesterday and that one goes away when I press a glass on it. But now there's something else. His skin is dark, so it's hard to see much, so I looked at his hands and feet and pulled his bottom eyelid down a bit. There are these tiny dark reddy dots on his palms and inside his eyelid. I pressed the glass on his palm and they were still there, they didn't change at all. He's wide awake, watching his cartoons and talking to me, and his lips and skin look normal. I'm so tired, I don't know if I should wake mum or what.
